# gitea_milestones (Data Source)

Use this data source to list milestones in a Gitea repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_milestones" "example" {
  user  = "my-org"
  repo  = "my-repo"
  state = "open"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Optional

- `state` (String) Filter state: `open`, `closed`, or `all`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `milestones` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--milestones))

<a id="nestedatt--milestones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `milestones`

Read-Only:

- `closed_issues` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `open_issues` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `title` (String)
